excluded.bluemap: Dedicated-server map service; not part of a client snapshot.
excluded.c2me-neoforge: Alternate chunk scheduling and storage are unnecessary for editing recorded scenes.
excluded.dynamic-fps: Background render suppression can leave Flashback capture frames black.
excluded.entityculling: Entity/block-entity visibility and tick suppression can affect recorded subjects.
excluded.ferrite-core: Optional memory optimization; retain native content implementations.
excluded.immediatelyfast: Optional rendering/batching hooks are excluded from the editing baseline.
excluded.lithium: Optional simulation optimization; retain native gameplay implementations.
excluded.modernfix: Optional loading, resource, and runtime optimizations are excluded.
excluded.moreculling: Additional model, leaf, and item-frame culling is excluded.
excluded.sodium-extra: Optional renderer settings and effects suppression are excluded.
